exposure: sPE without SGA vs. isolated SGA
sPE with SGA vs. isolated SGA
Severe preeclampsia (sPE) with small for gestational age (SGA) fetuses
outcome: Neonatal composite score (low 5-min APGAR, NICU admission, neonatal death)
finding: Women with severe preeclampsia (sPE) with SGA fetuses, similar to those with sPE without SGA, had a significantly higher risk of adverse neonatal outcomes, placental abruption, and cesarean delivery compared to women with isolated SGA.
mod_finding: While the study doesn't focus on mode of delivery as a primary exposure, it indicates an increased risk of cesarean delivery in women with sPE with SGA and sPE without SGA compared to isolated SGA.
birth_weight: SGA defined as birthweight<10th percentile, analysis repeated with SGA defined as birthweight<5th percentile
